function.name: impl_from_IGlobalInterfaceTable
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is used to specify the interface for which the containing record is to be returned.

function.return_type: StdGlobalInterfaceTableImpl pointer, represents the containing record for the given interface.

function.name: StdGlobalInterfaceTable_FindEntry
function.description: This function searches for an entry in the global interface table using a given cookie.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the instance of the global interface table implementation.

parameters.name: cookie
parameters.description: The cookie that identifies the entry to be found in the global interface table.

function.return_type: StdGITEntry*, represents the entry found in the global interface table. If no entry is found, it returns NULL.

function.name: StdGlobalInterfaceTable_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface is implemented. If it is, it increments the reference count and returns S_OK. If the interface is not implemented, it returns E_NOINTERFACE. If the ppvObject pointer is null, it returns E_INVALIDARG.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: The interface to check.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: The identifier of the interface.

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: A pointer to the location where the interface pointer will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can be S_OK if the operation was successful, E_NOINTERFACE if the interface is not implemented, or E_INVALIDARG if the ppvObject pointer is null.

function.name: StdGlobalInterfaceTable_AddRef
function.description: This function is used to add a reference to the global interface table.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the global interface table.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the reference count after adding a reference.

function.name: StdGlobalInterfaceTable_Release
function.description: This function is a stub that simply returns 1.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IGlobalInterfaceTable interface

function.return_type: ULONG, represents a 32-bit unsigned integer. In this function, it always returns 1.

function.name: StdGlobalInterfaceTable_RegisterInterfaceInGlobal
function.description: This function registers an interface in a global interface table. It marshals the interface, creates a new entry in the table, and returns a cookie that can be used to retrieve the interface later.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the global interface table in which the interface is to be registered.

parameters.name: pUnk
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface to be registered.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface to be registered.

parameters.name: pdwCookie
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the cookie for the registered interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the interface is not valid, it returns E_INVALIDARG. If the function fails to allocate memory for the new entry, it returns E_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: StdGlobalInterfaceTable_RevokeInterfaceFromGlobal
function.description: This function revokes an interface from the global interface table. It finds the entry in the table using the provided cookie, removes it from the list, releases the marshal data and the stream, and finally frees the entry.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface that needs to be revoked from the global interface table

parameters.name: dwCookie
parameters.description: A unique identifier that represents the interface in the global interface table

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the entry is not found, or other HRESULT values if releasing the marshal data fails

function.name: StdGlobalInterfaceTable_GetInterfaceFromGlobal
function.description: This function retrieves an interface pointer from the global interface table using a cookie. It also handles critical sections and error checking.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface in the global interface table.

parameters.name: dwCookie
parameters.description: Cookie associated with the interface pointer.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface to be retrieved.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Address of the pointer variable that receives the interface pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. S_OK if successful, error code otherwise.

function.name: GlobalInterfaceTable_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of the Global Interface Table (GIT). If the GIT does not exist, it initializes it and assigns it to the 'std_git' pointer. It then calls the 'IGlobalInterfaceTable_QueryInterface' function.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the class factory interface

parameters.name: outer
parameters.description: Pointer to the controlling unknown, if any

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, otherwise it returns the result of the 'IGlobalInterfaceTable_QueryInterface' function call.

function.name: release_std_git
function.description: This function releases the standard GIT (Global Interface Table) by removing entries from the list, releasing the marshal data and the stream, and finally freeing the memory allocated to the GIT and its entries.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, meaning this function does not return any value.
